answer: Each identity holds a garden plot that grows only when its owner answers a live roll-call in one random 10-minute dawn window per epoch, from a knoll roster. Windows scatter, so one operator cannot batch them. Five auditors check the roll-call log each epoch. A missed window halves the plot weight, a second zeroes it, and faked liveness burns the plot and voids the identity for 10 epochs. One operator covers about 2 windows per dawn, so 100 clones need 50 hired hands at $30 a dawn, $10,500 a week, against $0 for 100 honest ones. A garden feeds only the gardener who shows up at sunrise.
